newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BNZ to make floating rate announcement next week.
newsitem.headline: BNZ to make floating rate announcement next week.

text.p: The Bank of New Zealand said on Friday it would make a "positive announcement" early next week in regard to its floating interest rate.
"We expect to make a very positive announcement early next week with regard to the floating rate," BNZ general manager of New Zealand banking Tony Casey told Television New Zealand.
Casey said the bank expected the wholesale market to stabilise over the next few days, and the BNZ was monitoring the situation daily.
Earlier on Friday AMP New Zealand's telephone banking subsidiary, Ergo Personal Financial Services Ltd, cut its floating home loan mortgage rate to 10.95 percent from 11.25 percent.
BNZ's floating rate is currently 11.50 percent.
